description: Verify up to 25 payments in one call for $0.25 ($0.05 when every claim is on the XRP Ledger) USDC (x402): give `claims` (same fields as verify_payment) or `csv` (header: chain,txHash,payee,token,minAmountRaw,payer,logIndex,invoiceId). Claims already checked cost nothing; if all of them were, nothing is charged. Returns one row per claim (format "csv" adds a reconciliation CSV).

requiredLevel.description: Proof level you need before releasing money (Base: tee_attested < zk_proven < resolved; Ethereum: finalized; XRPL: unl_quorum). The answer then says whether it is releasable.

name: verify_payments_batch
